subject: Random Number in Transformed Parameters Block

messages.author: f8d226a46233641b
messages.subject: Random Number in Transformed Parameters Block
parts:
Hi everyone,


I would like to use a randomly generated number in the “transformed parameters” block, a number that is drawn independently from a fixed distribution each time transformed parameters is run.  I gather that users cannot call the rng functions within the transformed parameters block.  If that's correct, is there any workaround I could use to accomplish this?


Thanks for your help!

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Random Number in Transformed Parameters Block
parts:
You're correct that there's no way to do this. That's
intentional because the result won't be a proper Bayesian
model because information only flows one way (that is, it
won't be a parameter).

What do you want to do with the result? You can always
define a parameter and give it that distribution, but then
the behavior won't be like an RNG, but like a parameter if
it's connected in any way to the model.

Otherwise, if you want something disconnected, you need
to use the generated quantities block. It's set up to
cut the tie between sampling the parameters and generating
things based on the fit parameters.

- Bob
